The '''T-65A3 X-wing''' was the [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighter]] flown by [[Rogue Squadron/Legends|Rogue Squadron]] in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]].<ref name="dt:o" />

It was outfitted with improved [[Deflector shield/Legends|shields]], [[Targeting computer/Legends|targeting computers]] and [[Laser cannon/Legends|laser cannons]].<ref name="negvv" /> The T-65A3 was also used by [[Gavin Darklighter]] in the '[[skipchaser]]' simulation against a [[Yuuzhan Vong]] [[Yorik-et|coralskipper]].<ref name="dt:o" />
